operational_changes.watchdog: Windows scheduled task 'rt1126-watchdog' created before the request; runs experiments/2026-11-26_training_resume/watchdog.cmd NAME at the deadline: `colab stop -s NAME` for ONLY the exact owned session name, then logs sessions/usage. Requires this PC to be on.
operational_changes.shared_runtime_with_seed2: After QUEUE_B_DONE and hash-checked retrieval of RT-DETR evidence, the YOLO seed-2 stage (experiments/2026-11-15_bdd_clearday_transfer/amendment_5_seeds.json) may start in the same owned runtime, in Colab's untouched system Python, only if projected total runtime age stays <= 22 h. Otherwise the session is stopped and seed 2 uses the second allocation. RT-DETR stage time = request to seed-stage start; the watchdog is then moved to the seed-stage deadline.

budget.accounting: Own allocated time (request to verified stop or stage hand-over) x verified own rate; account balance deltas are context only.

failure_limits: At most 2 failures per stage, then stop and hand back; no optimisation loops, no automatic retry schedule.
